_comment: Shared HTTP memory MCP block for Claude Code (CLI · Web · Mobile). Copy to the
consumer repo as .mcp.json (git-tracked) OR register user-scope via:
claude mcp add-json --scope user l9-shared-memory '<the server object below>'
This file holds ONLY ${...} env-references — never a bearer token. Claude Code
expands L9_MEMORY_HTTP_URL / L9_MEMORY_CLIENT_TOKEN at runtime from the account
Default URL is the production HTTPS control plane. Allowlist
memory.quantumaipartners.com in web/network-policy.md when using Custom network access.
IDENTITY: group_id (repo namespace) is shared across agents; writing identity is not.
Claude Code uses its own bearer → principal (agent_id=claude-code). See
AUTHORITY: this is the authoritative memory MCP for all hosted/managed environments.
It supersedes the legacy self-hosted local-tunnel config in ops/graphiti/mcp.json.example
(graphiti-memory @ 127.0.0.1:8100 over SSH tunnel), which is kept only for VPS self-hosting.
